title: Empty Cookie Parsing
detail: If the cookie string is not empty but contains no valid cookies, the function returns an empty `ImmutableMultiDict` instead of parsing the cookies correctly.

title: Error Handling in Cookie Parsing
detail: Using `errors="replace"` when decoding the cookie value can lead to data loss if non-UTF-8 characters are present.

title: Incorrect argument passing
detail: The `parse_cookie` function is called with `cookie` and `**kwargs`, but `parse_cookie` in `http.py` does not accept `**kwargs`. This will cause a `TypeError` when calling `parse_cookie` with additional keyword arguments.

title: Incorrect argument passing
detail: The `parse_cookie` function is called with `combined_cookie` and `**kwargs`, but `parse_cookie` in `http.py` does not accept `**kwargs`. This will cause a `TypeError` when calling `parse_cookie` with additional keyword arguments.

title: Incorrect domain boundary handling
detail: Stripping the leading dot from the host can lead to incorrect domain boundary checks. This should be handled more carefully.

title: Incorrect condition logic
detail: The condition checks if the hostname is not equal to the host or if the host_with_port is equal to the host. This logic is incorrect and should be revised to properly handle domain boundary checks.
